parsed.rationale: Three types in the same `Playlist` package — `Announcement` (in `_Plant_Announcement.swift:19`), `Breakpoint` (in `PlaylistEntry.swift:57`), and `Talkset` (in `PlaylistEntry.swift:96`) — all carry an exactly identical initializer `init(id:hour:chronOrderID:timeCreated:)`. Because all three share the same parameter labels and live in the same package with no restraint markers, the initializer body is almost certainly identical boilerplate. The idiomatic Swift fix is to define a protocol (e.g., `PlaylistEntry`) with these four properties, then provide a default `init` in a protocol extension so each conforming type inherits it without repetition. This eliminates three copies of the same initializer and makes the shared contract explicit.
